snippet.title: REMATCH - Official Gameplay Breakdown - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
FGS Live From gamescom latam shared a new gameplay trailer for REMATCH, an exciting new take on the beautiful game from Sifu-developer Slocap featuring intense 5v5 online matches. The trailer outlines the game’s ‘four golden rules’ and invites players to take part in the upcoming Open Beta. Coming to PC, PS5 and Xbox on June 19, 2025. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescomlatam
